> Official Website: https://hasanshah.ir — Languages: Persian (fa), English (en), Arabic (ar)

## About Hasan Shahmoradi
Hasan Shahmoradi (Persian: حسن شاهمرادی / حسن شامرادی, Arabic: حسن شهمرادي, online handle: @shahbusinessman) is an Iranian web engineer and product architect from Tehran, Iran. He has over 8 years of professional experience building high-converting web applications and digital products for Iranian and regional businesses. He is recognized as the pioneer educator of Vibe Coding in Iran — a methodology where founders and builders create production-grade software by directing advanced AI reasoning models rather than writing repetitive manual syntax.

Technical stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cursor IDE, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI Codex, GitHub, Vercel.

## Core Services & Boutique Client Model
1. **High-Converting Web Platforms**: Bespoke web applications, sales funnels, and performance-first landing pages built with React and Next.js, engineered for commercial conversion rate optimization (CRO).
2. **Strict Client Intake Cap**: To maintain luxury craftsmanship and undivided attention, client intake is strictly capped at **2 to 3 selective projects per month**. Prospective clients apply and enter a qualification waitlist.
3. **Complimentary 30-Minute Strategic Session**: A focused 30-minute evaluation session to audit business goals, assess product feasibility, and verify mutual fit before project kickoff.
4. **Vibe Coding Masterclasses & Keynotes**: Interactive workshops, community meetups in Tehran, and online curricula teaching non-programmers to build full-stack web products with AI.
5. **Enterprise Dev-Team Bootcamp (/clients/dev-team-bootcamp/)**: Tailored executive training and curriculum for software development teams and CTOs looking to 5x sprint velocity through autonomous agentic workflows and Vibe Coding principles.

## Career Journey & Story Timeline (About Page)
- URL: https://hasanshah.ir/about/
- Description: Full interactive visual album and career roadmap of Hasan Shahmoradi across five distinct epochs:
  1. 2018–2019 (1397–1398): "3soot" On-Demand Warm Bread Logistics Startup (3soot.app) — first entrepreneurship venture, mobile app launch on Aparat, and logistics operations.
  2. 2019–2020 (1398–1399): Startup Shutdown & COVID-19 Era — key lessons from failure, business resilience, and strategic pivot toward consumer psychology and sales.
  3. 2020–2023 (1399–1402): 5 Years of Heavy Video Marketing & Industrial Copywriting — viral reels, B2B commercial campaigns (e.g. mr_countertop.ir), and mastering viewer retention hooks.
  4. 2023–2024 (1402–1403): Front-end Engineering & High-Converting Websites — building custom React/Next.js platforms with speed and conversion architecture.
  5. 2024–Present: Leading Vibe Coding in Iran — teaching entrepreneurs to ship complete web apps and digital products by directing AI models in natural language.
